statement.zh: 将哈苏纳表述为「美索不达米亚最早村落/唯一最早陶作文化」属于简化排名，需与同时期其他北部新石器传统对照。
statement.en: Calling Hassuna ‘the earliest village / sole earliest pottery culture in Mesopotamia’ is a simplifying ranking that must be checked against other northern Neolithic traditions.

disclaimer: Hypothesis / popular ranking — not a closed fact. Sequence definition ≠ unique primacy claim.
